Who we are

Friendship with a purpose.

Nisvartha Geleyara Balaga — NGB — brings people together around a simple belief: when a community acts with care, even small contributions can make a real difference.

Through regular social-service activities, our members work to support people and communities in need. We aim to serve respectfully, work together and encourage more people to take part.

People firstRespect and dignity for everyone.
Service togetherEvery helping hand matters.
Consistent actionTurning good intentions into action.
Open heartsWelcoming people who want to help.
What guides us

Service is stronger when we do it together.

Our work is rooted in compassion, teamwork and a commitment to making support meaningful.

♡ Compassion

We listen, care and respond to people with empathy and respect.

✳ Community

We bring friends and well-wishers together to make collective action possible.

↗ Meaningful action

We focus on practical service and encourage others to contribute their time and skills.
